timeline.summary: He presents being present as a habit and says his three-second rule is meant to prevent delay from pulling someone out of the moment.
He contrasts being capable in ordinary life with becoming tense and unlike oneself on a date because of fear of rejection or lost attention.
He says worry about an unrealized future changes speech and behavior and can lead to visible mistakes.
He claims attraction may take time to build but can drop within seconds after an awkward act; the ASR after the media cut is excluded.
